name: Kneaders Bakery & Cafe (Draper / South Jordan / Logan) Chunky Cinnamon French Toast & Turkey Croissant
brandOrRestaurant: Kneaders Bakery & Cafe (Draper, South Jordan/Riverton & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Kneaders' famous thick-sliced Chunky Cinnamon French Toast with caramel cream syrup and their flaky Turkey Bacon Avocado Croissant/Focaccia sandwiches are soft, seedless Utah classics.
prepOrOrderInstructions: For breakfast, order the Chunky Cinnamon French Toast (hold the fresh strawberries on top if avoiding seeds, and take a Lactaid for the cream syrup); for lunch, order the Turkey Bacon Avocado on a flaky croissant or focaccia (no lettuce/tomato/red onion).
watchOuts: Hold the fresh strawberry garnish on the French Toast during flares
Rich cream in the Kneaders caramel syrup
